welcome:
Welcome to PGK Wallet.
Use the buttons below.
help_text: To pay, open the invoice link you received and follow the steps.
payment_not_detected: ⏳ Payment not detected yet. Please try again in a few minutes.
payment_confirmed: ✅ Your payment has been confirmed. Thank you.
payment_underpaid: ❌ The received amount is less than the invoice. Status: underpaid.
payment_overpaid: ⚠️ The received amount is more than the invoice. Support has been notified.
payment_manual_review: 🕵️ Your payment was sent for manual review.
fiat_upload_prompt: 📤 Please upload your payment receipt (image or document).
fiat_receipt_received: ✅ Your receipt was received and is awaiting admin review.
fiat_customer_approved: ✅ Your fiat payment has been approved.
fiat_customer_rejected: ❌ Your fiat payment was rejected. Please contact support.
generic_error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again later.
